title: Student Medication Request Form
subtitle: Capture medication identity, label match, dose schedule source, and storage custody; confirm administration record and return.
description: Student Medication records medication identity, label match, dose schedule source, storage custody, administration record, and return. Student Medication evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this student medication request intake when staff must document medication identity and label match. Reconcile dose schedule source, storage custody, administration record, and return before the student medication handoff. Use the prescriber order, pharmacy label, guardian authorization, administration schedule, locked-storage inventory, dose log, variance report, expiration check, and return receipt. This record centers the pharmacy label, prescriber or qualified order, scheduled dose, staff administration entry, supply quantity, locked custody, missed or refused event, and medication return. For student medication live use, check roster. Reconcile the student medication schedule and actual handoff times. Preserve the student medication roster and schedule. Record the student medication handoff time and instructions. Close the student medication exception queue. Verify student medication day-of-service timing. Resolve student medication real-time changes and operating handoff for student medication. Ask the assigned student medication reviewer to confirm medication identity against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Student Medication requester details review
sections.guidance: Match student, medication label, qualified dose schedule, administration time, supply count, storage custody, variance record, expiration, and return. Keep any urgent student medication issue with its escalation contact and time.

sections.title: Student Medication request scope review
sections.guidance: Separate the requested outcome from constraints and optional items.

blocks.label: Student Medication request checks
items: Medication identity is identified for this record
Label match matches the current request or source
Dose schedule source is ready for point-of-use staff
Storage custody limits or questions are resolved

sections.title: Student Medication response
sections.guidance: Record the authorized response without promising an unapproved outcome.
